name: atec Dir Scan
author: docjojo

sections.description:
This plugin scans the complete WordPress directory for files/directories and displays the result in a scrollable directory tree with the number of files and size per directory.

Third-Party Services

Integrity check

Once, when activating the plugin, an integrity check is requested from our server – if you give your permission.
Source: https://atecplugins.com/
Privacy policy: https://atecplugins.com/privacy-policy/

3rd party scripts

The plugin uses “basicLightbox” to preview images.
Source code @ https://github.com/electerious/basicLightbox/

The plugin uses “jsTree” to display directory trees.
Source code @ https://www.jstree.com/
sections.installation:
1. Upload the plugin to /wp-content/plugins/ or install via the WP admin panel.
  2. Activate the plugin from the Plugins menu.
  3. Select “atec Dir Scan” link in admin menu bar.
